newsitem.title: INDIA: India HPCL Apr 96-Jan 97 sales up 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: India HPCL Apr 96-Jan 97 sales up 8.8 pct.

text.p: India's state-run oil refiner Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HPCL) said it sold 12.69 million tonnes of petroleum products from April 1996 to January 1997, an 8.8 percent rise over the year-ago period.
HPCL chairman H.L.Zutshi told reporters HPCL's sales volumes growth was 2.0 percent higher than the industry average.
He did not give the value of the sales.
He said HPCL's share of the Indian market was 20.06 percent.
HPCL hopes to increase its market share to 25 percent by the turn of the century, a company brochure said.
HPCL is India's second largest refiner.
